mapper.sql: encode(ST_AsEWKB(ST_Multi(ST_CollectionExtract(ST_Force2D( CASE WHEN ST_SRID(${col}) = 0 THEN ST_SetSRID(${col}, 4326) ELSE ST_Transform(${col}, 4326) END), 3))), 'hex')
mapper.select: SELECT projectid AS project_id, AS project_no, AS project_name, CASE WHEN stage_dm ILIKE 'Detailed%Minor%' THEN 'Minor Amendment' WHEN stage_dm ILIKE 'Detailed%Time%' THEN 'Time Extension' WHEN stage_dm ILIKE 'Detailed%' THEN 'Detailed' WHEN stage_dm ILIKE 'Concept%' THEN 'Concept' WHEN stage_dm ILIKE 'Enquiry%' THEN 'Enquiry' ELSE 'Other' END AS stage, stage_dm AS stage_raw, CASE WHEN approvalyear ~ '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN approvalyear::int END AS approval_year, AS developer_name, municipality AS src_municipality, CASE municipality WHEN 'Abu Dhabi' THEN 'ADM' WHEN 'Al Ain' THEN 'AAM' WHEN 'Western Region' THEN 'WRM' END AS municipality_code, AS src_district_id, AS src_community_id, AS masterplan_level, AS project_type, AS project_lead, AS owner_name, AS parent_project_no, AS geom_hex FROM ${t.masterplanBoundary} WHERE projectid IS NOT NULL AND shape IS NOT NULL

SELECT coalesce(objectid_1, objectid) AS src_objectid, projectid AS project_id, AS masterplan_type, AS approval_status, AS udm_gisid, AS udm_plot_number, AS registered_land_use, AS land_use_l1, AS land_use_l2, md_plot_area AS plot_area_sqm, floor_area_ratio AS far, building_storey AS building_storeys, number_of_buildings AS buildings, residential_population, total_residential_units, hotel_rooms, coalesce(total_gfa, calc_total_gfa) AS total_gfa, residential_gfa, office_gfa, retail_gfa, hotel_gfa, industrial_gfa, commercial_recreation_gfa, religious_gfa, education_gfa, healthcare_gfa, community_facilities_gfa, AS geom_hex FROM ${t.masterplanPlot}
SELECT coalesce(constructionsiteid::text, 'o' || objectid) AS site_id, AS description, AS municipality_code, AS geom_hex FROM ${t.constructionSite} WHERE shape IS NOT NULL
